name: EPIC 248865966
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 9.8 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248865966 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.762871 (16th-84th percentiles 9.438938-10.249366), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,523 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.82 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,846 K at its surface.
